content_of_post_to_answer: What kind of music or background noise is best for studying late at night when you're completely exhausted?
answer: When you're completely exhausted, the problem is rarely the absence of the right music; it is that your brain is running out of attention. Lyrics often add another task, while steady, predictable sounds can reduce mental friction. I’ve written more about how environment shapes focus on my profile, if you want to explore that pattern further. The best background is not what energizes you, but what asks the least from you.
